name: When You Call: Reprise
source:
A reanimated corpse (that being you), a sentient ring, and an amnesiac fiend walk into a bar. Sounds like the beginning of a bad joke? It’s not. It’s your life from the moment you woke up on a morgue slab.

Your number one priority? Escape the clutches of the mad Warlock. You’re an (aspiring? re-aspiring? You’ve done it once already, damn it) eldritch being, not a lab rat!

[From [url=https://pdrr.itch.io/when-you-call-reprise]itch.io[/url]

This game is an indirect sequel to the non-VN interactive fiction [url=https://pdrr.itch.io/im-the-echo-when-you-call]I'm the Echo when You call[/url], continuing from ending 4 of that game.
translation:
一具复活的尸体（也就是你）、一枚拥有意识的戒指，以及一个失忆的恶魔走进了酒吧。听起来像某个烂笑话的开头？并不是。从你在停尸台上醒来的那一刻起，这就成了你的生活。

你的首要任务是什么？逃出那个疯狂术士的魔掌！你可是个志在成为远古异神的存在——或者说，重新成为？该死，你明明已经成功过一次了——才不是什么实验鼠！

[摘自[url=https://pdrr.itch.io/when-you-call-reprise]itch.io[/url]]

本作是非视觉小说类互动小说[url=https://pdrr.itch.io/im-the-echo-when-you-call]《I’m the Echo when You Call》[/url]的间接续作，承接该作的结局4。
